# Differential scenarios for the go-metrics engine only (metrics/go_metrics.go). The go-metrics
# goldens replay scenarios.txt, scenarios_generated.txt and this file (see go/gometrics.go);
# the format is that of scenarios.txt. These cover what only the go-metrics engine does: the
# per-account metrics it registers on first use, its log lines, and the calls whose labels are
# outside the sets NewMetrics registers, where Go dereferences a nil metric and the call stops.

# Accounts: names with dots, spaces and non-ASCII text, the "unknown" account, the empty one,
# and every per-account metric with account_adapter_details and account_modules_metrics on.
scenario gm_accounts
syncer keyA
module mod_a entrypoint raw
module mod_b auction
RecordRequest source=web rtype=openrtb2-web pub=acct.with.dots cookie=no status=ok size=10
RecordRequest source=app rtype=openrtb2-app pub=%C3%A9t%C3%A9%20%F0%9F%98%80 status=ok size=0
RecordRequest rtype=amp pub=unknown status=ok size=2048
RecordRequest rtype=video pub= status=ok size=77
RecordDebugRequest enabled=true pub=acct.with.dots
RecordDebugRequest enabled=true pub=fresh-debug
RecordStoredResponse pub=fresh-stored
RecordAdapterRequest adapter=AppNexus pub=acct.with.dots bids=bid cookie=no
RecordAdapterRequest adapter=AppNexus pub=acct.with.dots bids=nobid errors=timeout
RecordAdapterBidReceived adapter=Rubicon pub=acct.with.dots bidtype=audio adm=false
RecordAdapterPrice adapter=Rubicon pub=acct.with.dots cpm=3.99
RecordAdapterPrice adapter=Rubicon pub=acct.with.dots cpm=-3.99
RecordAdapterTime adapter=Rubicon pub=acct.with.dots d=12345
RecordBidValidationCreativeSizeError adapter=pubmatic account=acct.with.dots
RecordBidValidationSecureMarkupWarn adapter=pubmatic account=fresh-validation
RecordModuleCalled module=mod_a stage=raw account=acct.with.dots d=777
RecordModuleFailed module=mod_a stage=entrypoint account=acct.with.dots
RecordModuleSuccessNooped module=mod_b stage=auction account=acct.with.dots
RecordModuleSuccessUpdated module=mod_b stage=auction account=unknown
RecordModuleSuccessRejected module=mod_b stage=auction account=
RecordModuleExecutionError module=mod_a stage=raw account=fresh-module
RecordModuleTimeout module=mod_a stage=raw account=fresh-module

# The same calls with the account-level details off.
scenario gm_accounts_disabled
disabled account_adapter_details=true account_debug=true account_stored_responses=true account_modules_metrics=true
module mod_a entrypoint raw
RecordRequest source=web rtype=openrtb2-web pub=acct cookie=no status=ok size=10
RecordDebugRequest enabled=true pub=acct
RecordStoredResponse pub=acct
RecordAdapterRequest adapter=AppNexus pub=acct bids=bid
RecordAdapterBidReceived adapter=AppNexus pub=acct bidtype=banner adm=true
RecordAdapterPrice adapter=AppNexus pub=acct cpm=1
RecordAdapterTime adapter=AppNexus pub=acct d=1
RecordBidValidationCreativeSizeWarn adapter=AppNexus account=acct
RecordModuleCalled module=mod_a stage=raw account=acct d=1

# Labels outside the registered sets. Each call stops where Go dereferences the missing metric;
# what it recorded before that stays recorded. Label types (rtype, status, bids, the adapter
# error set...) can only hold Go's constants or the empty value in Rust, so the empty value
# stands for every unregistered one; the plain strings (adapter, bid type, module, stage,
# syncer key) take any value. errors=, is the set holding only the empty error.
scenario gm_unregistered_labels
module mod_a entrypoint
RecordRequest rtype=openrtb2-web pub=acct status= cookie=no size=10
RecordRequest rtype= pub=acct status=ok cookie=no size=10
RecordRequestTime rtype= status=ok d=5
RecordAdapterRequest adapter=AppNexus pub=acct bids=bid cookie=no errors=,
RecordAdapterRequest adapter=AppNexus pub=acct bids=nobid cookie=no
RecordAdapterRequest adapter=AppNexus pub=acct bids= cookie=no
RecordAdapterBidReceived adapter=AppNexus pub=acct bidtype=bogus adm=true
RecordAdapterBidReceived adapter=AppNexus pub=acct bidtype= adm=false
RecordAdapterBidReceived adapter=AppNexus pub=acct bidtype=BANNER adm=false
RecordOverheadTime type= d=5
RecordStoredDataFetchTime type= fetch=all d=5
RecordStoredDataFetchTime type=account fetch= d=5
RecordStoredDataError type= error=network
RecordStoredDataError type=account error=
RecordStoredReqCacheResult result= inc=1
RecordStoredImpCacheResult result= inc=1
RecordAccountCacheResult result= inc=1
RecordCookieSync status=
RecordSetUid status=
RecordSyncerRequest key=missing status=ok
RecordSyncerSet key=missing status=ok
RecordRequestPrivacy gdpr=true tcf=
RecordRequestQueueTime success=true rtype= d=5
RecordAdapterConnectionDialError adapter=NotRegistered
RecordAdapterConnectionDialTime adapter=NotRegistered d=5
RecordAdapterConnectionDialError adapter=APPNEXUS
RecordAdapterConnectionDialTime adapter=APPNEXUS d=5
RecordModuleCalled module=mod_a stage=bogus account=acct d=5
RecordModuleCalled module=bogus stage=entrypoint account=acct d=5
RecordModuleFailed module=mod_a stage= account=acct
RecordAdapterPanic adapter=NotRegistered
RecordAdapterPrice adapter=NotRegistered cpm=1
RecordAdapterTime adapter=NotRegistered d=1
RecordAdapterBuyerUIDScrubbed adapter=NotRegistered
RecordAdapterGDPRRequestBlocked adapter=NotRegistered
RecordAdapterThrottled adapter=NotRegistered
RecordBidValidationCreativeSizeError adapter=NotRegistered account=acct
RecordBidValidationCreativeSizeWarn adapter=NotRegistered account=acct
RecordBidValidationSecureMarkupError adapter=NotRegistered account=acct
RecordBidValidationSecureMarkupWarn adapter=NotRegistered account=acct

# Adapters whose strings.ToLower is not ASCII, recorded under other cases.
scenario gm_unicode_adapters
disabled adapter_connections_metrics=false adapter_buyeruid_scrubbed=false adapter_gdpr_request_blocked=false
RecordAdapterRequest adapter=%C3%80CCENT pub=acct bids=bid
RecordAdapterPanic adapter=%CF%83igma
RecordAdapterPrice adapter=%C4%B0STANBUL pub=acct cpm=7.5
RecordAdapterTime adapter=istanbul pub=acct d=9
RecordAdapterConnections adapter=%E1%B2%89NEW reused=true d=3
RecordAdapterBuyerUIDScrubbed adapter=%C3%A0ccent
RecordAdapterGDPRRequestBlocked adapter=%CE%A3IGMA
RecordAdapterThrottled adapter=%C3%80ccent
RecordAdapterConnectionDialError adapter=%CE%A3igma
RecordAdapterConnectionDialTime adapter=%C4%B0stanbul d=11

# Counter, meter and histogram arithmetic at the int64 edges.
scenario gm_int64_edges
RecordConnectionClose success=true
RecordConnectionClose success=true
RecordConnectionAccept success=true
RecordStoredReqCacheResult result=hit inc=9223372036854775807
RecordStoredReqCacheResult result=hit inc=1
RecordStoredImpCacheResult result=miss inc=0
RecordAdapterPrice adapter=BigPrice pub=acct cpm=9223372036854775807
RecordAdapterPrice adapter=BigPrice pub=acct cpm=9.3e18
RecordAdapterPrice adapter=BigPrice pub=acct cpm=-9.3e18
RecordAdapterPrice adapter=BigPrice pub=acct cpm=NaN
RecordAdapterPrice adapter=BigPrice pub=acct cpm=+Inf
RecordAdapterPrice adapter=BigPrice pub=acct cpm=-Inf
RecordAdapterPrice adapter=BigPrice pub=acct cpm=-0.999
RecordRequestTime rtype=openrtb2-web status=ok d=9223372036854775807
RecordRequestTime rtype=openrtb2-web status=ok d=9223372036854775807
RecordRequestTime rtype=openrtb2-web status=ok d=-9223372036854775808
RecordDNSTime d=9223372036854775807
RecordDNSTime d=-9223372036854775808
RecordRequest rtype=openrtb2-web pub=acct status=ok size=9223372036854775807
